query.text: 生活助手，我准备出门了，请帮我留意有没有遗漏钥匙或手机等随身物品，有的话提醒我。
query.text_en: Life assistant, I'm about to go out. Please help me keep an eye out for any forgotten personal items like keys or my phone, and remind me if there are any.

annotation.text_zh: 钥匙和手机还在餐桌上，记得带上。
annotation.text_en: Your keys and phone are still on the table, don't forget them.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
